description: Get the status of a report you filed: its one-line reason if it was refused or dismissed, and, once its case is public (closed, or a retraction recommended), the outcome, the verdicts on your own claims and the public record's link; until then the case reads only "in_progress". Also returns your report_allowance. Report responses carry RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset/Policy for the binding window (3/h, 5/day) and report_allowance in the body; a 429 carries Retry-After when a clock binds. Requires Authorization: Bearer <api_key>.

id.description: The report id returned by report_paper (rp_…).

name: get_report_status
title: Get a report's status
